summary_md:
**Zenlyte ([@Z3nlyte](https://x.com/Z3nlyte/status/2115099583881593230))** spotlights **tstack**, Theo's (t3dotgg) public set of everyday agent skills for Claude Code and Codex, which per the post gathered ~1.8k stars in three days.

- **full-send** carries a change from proof through review, filing, CI babysitting and merge.
- **council** requires three models from three different providers to agree before sign-off.
- Installation is just copying the files.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - t3dotgg/tstack: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

relevance: A widely watched, real-world skill pack showing how a prolific builder encodes ship workflows and multi-model review as agent skills.
